question: Which country hosted the Football World Cup, 2022?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Qatar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Football World Cup 2022** was hosted by **Qatar**, marking the first time the tournament was held in the **Middle East**.
 
• The event took place from **November 20 to December 18, 2022**, deviating from its usual summer schedule due to the **extreme heat conditions in Qatar**.
 
• Qatar invested heavily in infrastructure, spending around **$220 billion**, which included the construction of state-of-the-art stadiums, transportation systems, and accommodations.
 
• A total of **64 matches** were played across **8 venues**, including iconic stadiums like **Lusail Iconic Stadium** and **Al Bayt Stadium**.
 
• The 2022 World Cup was notable for its focus on **sustainability**, featuring eco-friendly stadiums and a commitment to reduce carbon emissions.
 
• The tournament concluded with **Argentina** winning the World Cup, defeating **France** in the final, held at Lusail Iconic Stadium.
 
• It was also historic for being the **last World Cup with 32 teams**; the next tournament in 2026 will feature **48 teams.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **UAE**__

 __
 
• The **United Arab Emirates (UAE)** has hosted several international sports events, including the **Asian Cup (2019)**, but it has not hosted the FIFA World Cup.
 
• UAE is known for its **luxurious infrastructure**, with cities like **Dubai** and **Abu Dhabi** being major tourist destinations.
 
 
 
• **Argentina**__
 __
 
• **Argentina** has a rich football history and won the FIFA World Cup in **1978** and **2022**, but it has never hosted the World Cup.
 
• The country is famous for its legendary football player **Diego Maradona** and the modern icon **Lionel Messi**.
 
 
 
• **France**__
 
 
• **France** hosted the FIFA World Cup in **1998**, where they emerged victorious, defeating Brazil in the final.
 
• France is known for its strong football legacy, having won the World Cup twice, in **1998** and **2018**.
